lines.text: In my day, tax collectors called publicani skimmed a cut off every coin.
lines.say: In my day, tax collectors called publi-carny skimmed a cut off every coin.

lines.text: So I kicked them out of Asia and cut the tax by a third.
Today, your fund managers do the same thing. It's called fees.
Over thirty years, a one percent fee can eat a quarter of your money.
And you pay it to a manager who probably can't even beat the market, you fucking idiot.
Choose low fees. Keep your gold.
